author: AbusiveUser
body:
Hello! today I will be introducing a new map called Obelis for the new gamemode called 'Sky Wars'. I built this map with my friend {tag=99522edd5edf40658861f7e280b7ff09} and we hope you like the map.
We added some easter eggs, try to find them because they are funny!

Islands:
  • Primary Islands: You will find 8 islands with 3 chests.
  • Secondary Islands: You will find 8 islands with 1 chest. (Islands with chest are in front of primary Islands)
  • Middle Island: You will find 6 chest in Middle and 1 hidden chest at top.




Creators: AbusiveUser & Bloodoh
Server hosted by: Bloodoh
Gamemode: Sky Wars
Recommended Size:
  • FFA: 8 players per Island
  • Teams: 16 players (2 per island)
Building Time: 4 hours
Feedback: None

- - - - - - - - - - - - - -
  • Full Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/39HRi
  • Download: Sorry, download will not be provided. (Map Developers hit me at Slack)
Well, that's all for today, remember that feedback is always appreciated and it will help me improve in our future maps. If you have any questions about my map, ask in the comments and I will try my best to answer quickly.
Thanks, ~Abusive!

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
I'm not really a fan of this. I'm looking at the screenshots, and I see the blocks this map is designed with are clashing together, there's not really a good island shape (needs jaggedness, including for PvP), the chests should be separated more and not 2 right next to each other, and lava is usually a no-no when it comes to Avicus. The middle island I'd also like to be reshaped, and visually I don't know how I'd feel with this map playing during daytime.

You can make some edits if you want.

replies.body: This map looks a lot better than any map from you i have ever seen here, these guys actually managed to use more blocks than just stone, and still somehow made it look good. They even added some height differences to the islands which makes it look waay better than 90% of the avicus maps that are 100% flat. I know this map doesn't look like any of your maps, but that does not mean it is bad.

replies.author: imryaan
replies.body:
The map looks really good. I like that block pallette !

I recommend to :

-Make the secondary islands just a bit bigger.
-Maybe add some holes in middle since its a big area and it would add some interesting gameplay.
- & Maybe add some spots of lava in middle aswell? Your choice.

Anyways, good job with this map!
